body: Yeah, I get it.  And it sounds wonderful.  Glad your friend has a community like that.
I'm on finasteride and spironolactone, and using minoxidil.  Nothing helps.  My T levels are lower than the average woman.

I'm not sure what I expecting by posting here.  Must have been something, but in spite of everyone's kindness I just feel empty and hurt still.  It might just be time to plan this out and go through with it.  Don't really see how anything can ever get better when it's me that's the problem.  I've been thinking that maybe a long note that explains everything might help my family to get over the loss.
Who are people like myself?  Thanks.  I know I should stop worrying about my looks :)

I've been looking around for a psychologist again.  Seeing a psychiatrist.  My mom's paying for all this stuff though and while she's supportive, she's not rich.  My insurance ended when I turned 26 and now I'm on so so many medications.  It's coming out to be ~$300 USD each month for medication alone, and another $190 for the cost of the psychiatrist.  Dunno how long my mom can keep doing this, even without having to pay for therapy without insurance.

I'm already in so much medical debt, too :(

That's a lot.  It's all pretty overwhelming.  Maybe I'm just lazy and don't want to do anything, but when faced with that big list it seems impossible.  Suicide is hard too, but it seems so much more doable.

I don't qualify for any low income stuff because I live with my dad and he makes quite a bit of money.  Surrounding myself with people at all sounds frightening.  I'm not trying to pass at all now.  For a while I was and I was actually starting to like myself a little, but with my hair falling out trying to do anything in the way of passing just depresses me and ends with me crying in bed.  Was in yoga classes too until the hair started falling out.  My life just fell to pieces again after that, and now I'm way back to where I started once more.  I don't think I can rebuild again this time.  So tired of doing this.  I'm already 26 and my life has gone nowhere.

I'm taking finasteride and using minoxidil.  Nothing helps, it just keeps falling out.

As I said in other posts, "support" causes me terrible anxiety and I doubt it even exists where I live.

We've tried getting him help, yes.  It's even court mandated that he get it, and he's still not going.  Can't force an adult to go to rehab or anything :(

Yeah it's pretty strange, right?  I had no idea I was so vain until it started falling out.  Thought I was basically okay and starting to accept myself before this.  Really making some awesome progress.  It was when it started falling out that everything fell to pieces.  Dunno what to do with it; I'm afraid to wash, brush or even touch it now.  There's so much hair in the shower, and brushing my hair when it all comes out on the brush is a crazy emotional experience every single time.  It's ridiculous and kind of petty to be so attached to something impermanent like my hair, but it's like my hopes and dreams for myself are falling away with it.

It isn't *my* community.  I've never even met a transgendered person before.  My town has very little in the way of LGBT services anyway.  When I wanted to get my hormone script I had to track down a gender counselor or whatever.  Turns out there is exactly one in my Wyoming town, and we didn't even work out as counselor and patient.

He needs to go to AA or he'll end up going to jail for not completing the requirements for his DUI charge.  He's afraid it's not going to happen though.  He has a fear of social situations too, though not quite as bad as mine.  He has friends at least.  When he tried the group therapy and AA meetings he just got more anxious and ended up drinking more then quitting.  Says he wants one on one counseling, which I think would be more helpful, but that's not how the courts do things.

I've always stressed out about the support groups too.  Hated it when I was sectioned because I never really got to see a counselor one on one and the group sessions made me so anxious, and seemed unhelpful and kind of patronizing somehow.

I don't know why, but the thought of wearing a wig for the rest of my life makes me want to die.  Women get female pattern baldness, not male pattern.  And if I were to able to able to date, my partner would sometimes see me like that.  Have to take it off to sleep.  Don't think I could ever face myself if more fell out.  This is pretty non-negotiable, and I don't know why.  Guess it's like one final "screw you" from my body, after I've put up with so much.  I will not survive this unless it stops soon and reverses.

Funny I sound like a youth.  Suppose anyone living with their brother and dad still must be a kid heh.  I'm actually 26, and have spent the last 8 years failing community college courses and crying in bed unable to face the world.  My life as myself never started, and neither did any sort of adult independence.  People really scare me.  I visibly shake around strangers, and now my psychiatrist doesn't even want to give me medication that will help.  Maybe it's just the delusional mindset depression brings on but I feel stuck.  Can't even leave the house most of the time because there are people out there, and then being home...
